title: CI Performance
description: Use the BuildBuddy invocation associated with the CI run for timings and cache statistics.

options.content:
[Galadril Bazel CI runs](https://github.com/Aeluin-Technologies/Galadril/actions/workflows/bazel.yaml)

Open the BuildBuddy invocation from the test job. Use its Timing and Cache views and open the integration test’s undeclared outputs for `integration-performance.json`.
